name: markdown-render
description: GitHub-flavored markdown in replies: Mermaid diagrams as images, alerts, task lists, footnotes, details/kbd

theme.title: Diagram theme
theme.description: Color theme for Mermaid diagrams. The first fifteen are derived from Ghostty's own theme files so a diagram matches your terminal; the last four are Mermaid built-ins.

renderer.title: Diagram renderer
renderer.description: auto prefers mmdr (native, no browser) and falls back to mermaid-cli (headless Chrome)

cellAspect.title: Terminal cell aspect
cellAspect.description: Cell height divided by width; raise it if diagrams look stretched tall, lower it if squashed

maxRows.title: Max diagram height (rows)
maxRows.description: Taller diagrams are scaled down to fit

retentionDays.title: Diagram cache retention (days)
retentionDays.description: Rendered diagrams older than this are deleted at session start

diagramLevel.title: Diagram eagerness
diagramLevel.description: How strongly the system prompt pushes Claude toward diagrams. off adds no section at all; minimal draws one only where it clearly beats prose; balanced draws one when three or more things connect; eager defaults to a diagram
